name: IoTProtocol
description: Universal binary IoT protocol for ESP8266/ESP32 over UDP. Package V4.3 adds persistent BOOT_ID, strict LittleFS config with CRC16, HMAC provider integration, reliable delivery, deduplication and session-aware ACK handling; wire format remains V4.1 (0x41).
keywords: iot, protocol, udp, sensor, binary, tlv, esp8266, esp32, crc16
